name: Comoé National Park
description: Comoé National Park covers about 11,500 square kilometres of north-eastern Côte d'Ivoire, making it the largest protected area in West Africa. The Comoé river works like a lifeline here, letting patches of dense rainforest grow in open savanna country far north of where they normally appear. Listed as endangered in 2003, the park recovered enough to leave that list in 2017.
